role: Python port of LiveDFAAnalyzer.cleanRRForDFA (LiveDFAAnalyzer.swift @ e028039): 5-beat trailing-median artifact mask (300-2000 ms gate, 20 % deviation) and in-place linear interpolation, with the 3 %/6 % corrected-fraction thresholds. Checked: the only Swift change since e028039 (to 8d32097) is comment text, so the port still matches main.

units.does: isArtifactBeat: true outside 300-2000 ms; false while fewer than 3 recent clean beats; else true when |rr-median|/median > 0.20 (upper median of the recent list).
Builds the artifact mask, appending each clean beat to a 5-element trailing list.
Replaces each flagged beat by linear interpolation between nearest clean neighbours (or copies the only neighbour); fully-flagged series stay unchanged.

cleanRRForDFA: series shorter than 8 returned unchanged with 0 corrections; else (interpolated values, number flagged). The input is always copied to floats first, so the caller never gets its own list back; artifact_mask flags the beats and _interpolate replaces them.
units.contract: Returns a pair: the cleaned series as a new list of floats, and the number of beats flagged. A series shorter than 8 comes back as a float copy with 0 corrections; otherwise the beats artifact_mask flags are replaced by _interpolate's values.

units.does: Corrected fraction count/len, 0 for an empty series.
